mediaAccess.expression: (http.host eq "test-store-media.vrclearn.com" and http.request.uri.path ne "/cdn-cgi/access/authorized" and (ip.src.country in {"XX" "T1"} or (ip.src.country eq "CN" and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cn/")) or (ip.src.country ne "CN" and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/intl/"))))
